issue.title: Maestro smoke: Home + drafting navigation
issue.body:
## Summary / context

Parent: #488.

After auth, prove Home tabs and drafting navigation: My Work / Projects → open chapter → Bible / Resources / Record tab bar.

## Current vs expected

**Current:** Manual QA opens projects/chapters by hand. No Maestro navigation smoke.

**Expected:** Stable Android flow(s) that assert tab and drafting shell ids (depends on selector ticket).

## Scope

**In scope**
- Smoke after login: My Work visible, Projects visible
- Open an assigned chapter/verse drafting screen
- Assert drafting tab bar: Bible, Resources, Record (`drafting-tab-bar` / tab ids)
- Optional: Resources tab opens without crash

**Out of scope**
- Actually recording audio (Record child)
- Prepare offline wizard
- Multi-account isolation

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] Flow green with Maestro account that has ≥1 assignment
- [ ] Navigation uses `testID`s (not chapter title text alone)
- [ ] Document required seed data (project/chapter) on the ticket/PR
- [ ] Empty My Work called out as a hard fail with clear message (assignment prerequisite)

## Verification / test plan

1. Sync after login so SQLite has projects
2. Run nav smoke on emulator
3. Confirm on nightly-shaped Release build if harness supports it

## Links

- Refs #488
- Home / `MyWorkTab` / `ProjectsTab` / `DraftingScreen`
